Odisha Police Unveils Security Plan for Puri Rath Yatra

The Odisha Police has unveiled a security blueprint for the upcoming Puri Rath Yatra, one of India's largest Hindu festivals. The plan involves deploying over 12,000 police personnel and using drones to monitor the event. The police coordination meeting was held on Tuesday, where the security plan was shared with stakeholders. This move aims to ensure public safety during the festival, which is expected to attract millions of devotees.
